تخترطين (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِطِينَ (taḵtariṭīna) /tax.ta.ri.tˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# تُخْتَرَطِينَ (tuḵtaraṭīna) /tux.ta.ra.tˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
